summary: This video showcases a Thunderbolt team battling Area Boss 3 (Abyssal Emissary) in Crisis Rally. The team composition features Perkunte, Alaura, Tariz, Shai'nachtan, and Maashtur. Together, they achieve over 10.95 billion total damage to reach S rank score. Full equipment builds, stats, and skill timing configurations are shown at the end of the run.
